motivation: The already frozen greedy causal-monotone control fixes assimilation at alpha=1. After that gate passed, a stricter fairness audit was required because PCHP uses a source-selected assimilation rate. This follow-up gives the no-harm-tube comparator its own source-only nested alpha selection and does not alter or erase the earlier result.
question: After matching target-information access, online state, monotonicity, physical range, alpha grid, source-only tuning effort, and candidate predictions, is the PCHP harm tube still active and useful?

inputs.purpose: Pins the 66 double-holdout prediction caches and the original source-only selection design.
Frozen outer-domain protected baseline and PCHP outputs.

comparator.name: source_tuned_causal_candidate
comparator.selection: For each outer target domain, choose alpha by minimizing inner-domain-equal cell-macro MAE over the other 11 source domains using double-holdout raw candidate predictions; break numerical ties in favor of the largest alpha.
matched_dimensions: same O(1) online state and time
comparator.controlled_difference: Only PCHP imposes the exact pointwise harm tube around the protected causal state.

frozen_gates.selection_integrity: All 12 outer domains have 11 source-only inner validation domains; all 66 frozen cache hashes match; no outer target label enters alpha selection.
frozen_gates.contract_activity: The source-tuned causal candidate violates the delta=0.01 pointwise contract in at least 9 of 12 domains and at least 25% of 586 cells, while PCHP has zero violations within 1e-12.
frozen_gates.utility: Either the source-tuned causal candidate does not improve the protected baseline and PCHP does, or PCHP retains at least 50% of the comparator's positive domain-equal MAE gain.
frozen_gates.online_properties: The comparator is exactly reproducible by two implementations, lies in [0,1.3], is non-increasing for every cell, and uses no outcome during outer prediction construction.
frozen_gates.roster_and_statistics: The outer evaluation contains 12 domains, 586 cells, and 601932 records; uncertainty uses 100000 bootstrap resamples of complete domains with seed 20260806.

decision_rule.RETAIN: All five gates pass. This becomes the main closest operational control; the earlier alpha=1 greedy control remains in the evidence ledger.
decision_rule.NARROW: Integrity, online, and roster gates pass but exactly one of contract_activity or utility fails. Report only as a boundary or appendix control.
decision_rule.REJECT: Any integrity, online, or roster gate fails, or both scientific gates fail. Do not use the control to support the central claim.
decision_rule.stop_rule: Do not modify alpha grid, tie-breaker, budget, domain roster, aggregation, or thresholds after outcome inspection.

chronology_boundary: Inner source and outer development outcomes have been opened previously. Nested source-only selection prevents outer-label tuning but does not make the final comparison prospective or confirmatory.
